title: Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Membership Agreement — Fees and Member Benefits
content:
**Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly** and **Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual** are the paid levels of Kestrel Care Rewards. This agreement sets the fee a Plus membership pays and the benefits a Plus member receives.

## Section 1 — Fee

1.1 A Plus membership pays the membership fee of its level every billing cycle of the level's length in months, the first charge falling after the level's free-trial days.

1.2 Each billing cycle is charged once.

## Section 2 — Member benefits

2.1 A Plus member receives the monthly Plus credit of Kestrel Cash on the first day of each calendar month.

2.2 A Plus member receives the store-brand discount of the level off Kestrel store-brand items.

2.3 Where the level carries free prescription delivery, the member's prescription deliveries carry no same-day or express fee, under the Delivery & Pickup Services terms.

## Schedule of fees and benefits

| Level | Membership fee per billing cycle (USD) | Billing cycle (calendar months) | Free trial before the first fee (calendar days) | Monthly Plus credit (USD) | Store-brand discount at checkout (percent) | Prescription deliveries free of same-day or express fees |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Member | 0.00 | 0 (free level) | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | no |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | 0.00 | 0 (free level) | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | no |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 0.00 | 0 (free level) | 0 | 0.00 | 5 | no |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 0.00 | 0 (free level) | 0 | 0.00 | 10 | no |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly | 5.00 | 1 | 30 | 10.00 | 20 | yes |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual | 48.00 | 12 | 0 | 10.00 | 20 | yes |

## Reading the agreement (hypothetical memberships)

- **Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly.** The membership pays 5.00 every 1 month. Its first 5.00 charge falls after 30 days of free trial. Each monthly cycle is charged once.
- **Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual.** The membership pays 48.00 every 12 months and has no free trial.
- **Monthly credit.** On the first day of each calendar month a Plus member receives 10.00 of Kestrel Cash, at either Plus level.
- **Store-brand items.** A Plus member buying Kestrel store-brand items receives 20 percent off them at checkout.
- **Prescription deliveries.** Both Plus levels carry free prescription delivery, so a Plus member's prescription deliveries carry no same-day or express fee under the Delivery & Pickup Services terms.

**A cycle already charged.** A billing cycle that has been charged is not charged a second time.
